summary: 6 features and 6 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • health: add grain-based health monitoring for Agent CLI, OmniRoute, and CodeServer (f0d6109)
  • frontend-config: expand chief complaint presets to eight additional locales (d4855dd)
  • signalr: add context title to remote voice input snapshot (faa8fd2)

HagiCode-org/web

  • remote-input: add QR code preview popover to remote input button (33f0775)
  • pwa: add Progressive Web App support with install prompt and push (1d7986b)
  • remote-input: add contextTitle to remote input pipeline and display active screen (9d7e3e1)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/web

  • data-aggregation: pass undefined instead of forceRefresh boolean to service (e81ef95)
  • drawer: skip redundant session detail fetch when already loaded (00174b3)
  • i18n: normalize escaped quotes in hero confirmDelete messages (d1115f8)
  • drawer: prevent dismissal when interacting with floating overlay layers (0b9130a)
  • wizard: adjust language grid layout for ten language options (0d4b339)
  • i18n: update remote input page title and description in zh locales (04a05ac)
